item.title: Rock, paper, scissors & millionaire: Aus Open's Million-Dollar 1 Point Slam
item.summary: The eagerly anticipated Australian Open is set to reintroduce the exciting Million-Dollar 1 Point Slam event in 2027. This thrilling exhibition match allows players to compete for a staggering prize of one million Australian dollars. After a successful inaugural run where an amateur triumphed, fans are looking forward to witnessing more suspenseful moments as one single point determines the fate of each match.
